banner.title: Launch Your Payment Gateway Like Zaxor
banner.content: Deploy a secure, multi-currency payment gateway with our Zaxor-inspired clone script. Accept crypto and fiat payments with customizable workflows and merchant tools.

about.title: From Payment Processing to Payment Orchestration
about.content: Traditional payment gateways focus on simple transaction routing. A Zaxor-style gateway combines multi-currency support, merchant dashboards, automated settlements, and compliance tools.Launch your own branded payment platform that handles crypto, fiat, and hybrid transactions with enterprise-grade security and scalability.

cardSectionOne.title: Your Business Needs Payments. Your Gateway Should Handle Everything.
cardSectionOne.description: Merchants demand seamless payment experiences across currencies, methods, and regions. Building a gateway from scratch requires heavy investment in security, compliance, and infrastructure.

content.paraTxt: Managing multiple payment methods, currencies, and settlement routes increases operational complexity.
Meeting PCI DSS, KYC/AML, and fraud prevention standards requires specialized expertise and audits.
Custom gateway development demands significant budgets for coding, testing, and ongoing maintenance.
Handling transaction spikes and global traffic requires robust, scalable infrastructure.

cardSectionOne.finalPoint: A Zaxor clone script provides pre-built payment flows, security modules, and merchant tools for rapid deployment.

cardSectionTwo.title: White-Label Gateways Built for Your Brand
cardSectionTwo.description: Every payment business has unique needs. Our clone scripts offer core functionality with full customization for features, branding, and integrations.

content.paraTxt: Replicate Zaxor-style features including multi-currency support, merchant dashboards, and automated settlements.
Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and other cryptocurrencies with instant conversion and wallet management.
Integrate credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and digital wallets for seamless fiat transactions.
Combine crypto and fiat payments in a single platform with unified reporting and settlement.
Provide merchants with real-time analytics, transaction history, refunds, and dispute management.
Extend or modify scripts with unique features, APIs, and third-party integrations.

clickableSec.title: Turn Payment Ideas Into Live Platforms
clickableSec.description: Whether you're serving e-commerce, SaaS, or marketplaces, our gateway scripts support diverse payment models.

content.paraTxt: Enable online stores to accept multiple payment methods with instant checkout and order tracking.
Support subscription billing, recurring payments, and automated invoicing for software businesses.
Facilitate split payments, vendor settlements, and commission management for multi-vendor platforms.
Process international payments with multi-currency support and competitive FX rates.
Allow customers to pay with crypto assets and auto-convert to fiat or stablecoins.
Route transactions across multiple processors to optimize success rates and costs.

devProc.title: From Script Selection to Production Launch
devProc.description: We follow a structured process to customize, integrate, and deploy your payment gateway with minimal friction.

content.paraTxt: We analyze your target markets, payment methods, compliance needs, and merchant workflows.
We recommend the best-fit clone (Zaxor, BitPay, NOWPayments) based on your business model.
We tailor UI/UX, add features, integrate payment processors, wallets, and APIs.
We perform security audits, PCI DSS compliance checks, and QA across all modules.
We launch your gateway on cloud infrastructure and provide ongoing maintenance.
We add new payment methods, optimize routing, and support your growth roadmap.

table.title: Clone Script vs Custom Development
table.description: Choosing between a gateway clone script and building from scratch depends on your timeline, budget, and feature requirements.
table.finalPoint: Clone scripts offer speed and cost-efficiency, while custom builds suit highly specialized, enterprise-grade requirements.

cardSectionThree.description: A well-built gateway script accelerates your entry into the payment industry while reducing operational overhead.

content.paraTxt: Launch in weeks instead of months and capture early-mover advantages.
Save up to 70% compared to building a gateway from scratch.
Benefit from pre-audited code, encryption, tokenization, and fraud detection.
Integrated PCI DSS, KYC/AML modules help meet global compliance standards.
Handle growing transaction volume without performance issues.
Get vendor updates, bug fixes, and feature enhancements post-launch.

cardSectionFour.title: We Build Gateways Around Your Business Goals
cardSectionFour.description: Our scripts are not one-size-fits-all. We tailor every module to align with your brand, merchants, and revenue model.

content.paraTxt: We prioritize your monetization strategy, merchant journey, and compliance needs.
Add or remove features like crypto, fiat, or subscriptions as your business evolves.
Fully white-label UI/UX to match your brand identity and market positioning.
Built with APIs, microservices, and cloud-native deployment for long-term growth.
